title: It feels like one thing.
text: Look at this little website. It seems like one thing.

title: Let's pull it apart.
text: But your browser builds it from three different kinds of instructions.

title: First, something to say.
text: HTML says what is here. A heading. Some words. A button.

title: The same words. A new feeling.
text: CSS changes how those same things look. Notice: the words have not changed.

title: Then, a reason to respond.
text: JavaScript gives the button a rule. Click, and the details appear.

title: Now, take a layer away.
text: Now it is yours. Take a layer away, and see what changes. You can always put it back.
